ligand_source: Selected v3 independent full-parent SDF only, canonical branch:CCD:atom map. No experimental bound ligand coordinate, receptor contact or docking result is used.
input_conversion: Retain every full-parent heavy atom and its existing v3 coordinates, use unchanged CCD residue and heavy-atom names, branch number as CNS residue number and chain B. Omit all input hydrogens so CNS builds hydrogens using its declared residue/link topology. No new embedding, minimization or heavy-atom coordinate fitting.
actual_parameterization_scope: Six independent glycan-only topoaa jobs, one CPU sequentially, debug=true and clean=false. No receptor or docking stages in these jobs. Receptor strict/repair topology gates are separate and remain required before prospective paired cohort execution.
downstream_information_condition: Pending root freeze: predicted top1 and oracle box metadata are shared with Vina, but a deterministic protein-only box-to-AIR conversion gives HADDOCK a different spatial restraint representation. It must not be described as exact information equivalence. Native-contact AIRs are forbidden.
downstream_sampling_proposal: Three predeclared CNS seeds and released 20-model glycan test sampling; rigidbody plus released clustering/selection and flexref settings. No native reference caprieval or native-interface clustering selections. The exact new cohort configs and box-to-AIR rule require a separate freeze before any pose generation.
